description: A bean holding an ordered list of security filters and the matcher that decides which requests it handles.
The HttpSecurity configuration style that passes a lambda to each feature, which is the only style Spring Security 7 supports.
Rules that pair a URL pattern with an access decision and are checked in order, with the first match winning.
hasRole adds the ROLE_ prefix and then compares the authority, while hasAuthority compares the exact string.
The interface that loads a user's name, password hash and authorities for a given username.
The interface that hashes passwords and checks a submitted password against a stored hash.
An encoder that stores the algorithm id as a prefix such as {bcrypt}, so algorithms can change over time.
